verses.translation: A Song of Degrees. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

translations.ron: Veselitu-m-am de cei ce mi-au zis mie: "În casa Domnului vom merge!"
translations.grk: Ὠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Εὐφράνθην ἐπὶ τοῖς εἰρηκόσι μοι, εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου πορευσόμεθα.

verses.translation: Our feet stood in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

translations.ron: Stăteau picioarele noastre în curţile tale, Ierusalime!
translations.grk: Ἑστῶτες ἦσαν οἱ πόδες ἡμῶν ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.translation: Jerusalem is built as a city whose fellowship is complete.

translations.ron: Ierusalimul, cel ce este zidit ca o cetate, ale cărei porţi sunt strâns-unite.
translations.grk: Ἱερουσαλὴμ οἰκοδομουμένη ὡς πόλις, ἧς ἡ μετοχὴ αὐτῆς ἐπιτοαυτό.

verses.translation: For thither the tribes went up, the tribes of the Lord, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

translations.ron: Că acolo s-au suit seminţiile, seminţiile Domnului, după legea lui Israel, ca să laude numele Domnului.
translations.grk: Ἐκεῖ γὰρ ἀνέβησαν αἱ φυλαὶ, φυλαὶ Κυρίου μαρτύριον τῷ Ἰσραὴλ, τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου.

verses.translation: For there are set thrones for judgment, even thrones for the house of David.

translations.ron: Că acolo s-au aşezat scaunele la judecată, scaunele pentru casa lui David.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐκάθισαν θρόνοι εἰς κρίσιν, θρόνοι ἐπὶ οἶκον Δαυίδ.

verses.translation: Pray now for the peace of Jerusalem: and let there be prosperity to them that love thee.

translations.ron: Rugaţi-vă pentru pacea Ierusalimului şi pentru îndestularea celor ce te iubesc pe tine.
translations.grk: Ἐρωτήσατε δὴ τὰ εἰς εἰρήνην τὴν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ εὐθηνία τοῖς ἀγαπῶσί σε.

verses.translation: Let peace, I pray, be within thine host, and prosperity in thy palaces.

translations.ron: Să fie pace în întăriturile tale şi îndestulare în turnurile tale.
translations.grk: Γενέσθω δὴ εἰρήνη ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου, καὶ εὐθηνία ἐν ταῖς πυργοβάρεσί σου.

verses.translation: For the sake of my brethren and my neighbours, I have indeed spoken peace concerning thee.

translations.ron: Pentru fraţii mei şi pentru vecinii mei grăiam despre tine pace.
translations.grk: Ἕνεκα τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου καὶ τῶν πλησίον μου, ἐλάλουν δὴ εἰρήνην περὶ σοῦ.

verses.translation: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I have diligently sought thy good.

translations.ron: Pentru casa Domnului Dumnezeului nostru am dorit cele bune ţie.
